svg.title: Role boundaries in the deep dive
svg.desc: Three nested boxes show how to describe your role on OptumRx Meteor. The innermost box is what you owned end to end: the GraphQL Consumer Service (schema, resolvers, upstream integration, caching, resilience), the React app built from the ground up with its micro-frontend architecture, the team's engineering standards, and leading the 8 to 10 engineer team. The middle box is what you collaborated on: API strategy and data integration patterns with senior architects. The outer box is what others decided and should be credited for: platform-level direction by the architects and the five upstream systems owned by their teams.
svg.text: Say what you owned, and credit the rest
OptumRx Meteor as the resume describes it. Interviewers probe these boundaries in a deep dive.
Others decided: "The architects set… / the upstream teams own…"
Platform-level direction (senior architects). The 5 upstream systems (their teams).
Collaborated: "I worked with the architects on…"
API strategy, scalable service architecture and data integration patterns.
Owned end to end: "I owned / I designed / I decided"
• GraphQL Consumer Service: schema, resolvers, upstream integration, caching
• React app built from the ground up, and its micro-frontend architecture
• Team engineering standards: testing, CI/CD, code quality, deployment
• Leading 8–10 engineers: planning, delegation, reviews, releases
Wording from the resume. Where your decisions ended and the architects' began is yours to confirm.
